headline: Barclays Upgrades Air France-KLM Rating Following Strong Results
summary: Barclays upgraded its investment rating for Air France-KLM stock, citing the European airline group's strong recent financial performance.
why: Air France-KLM is one of Europe's largest airline conglomerates.
